title: Insecure Login Credentials
description: The student may use weak or easily guessable passwords, leading to unauthorized access to their account.

title: Data Leakage through Misconfiguration
description: The Grades Portal Web App may have misconfigured settings that allow unauthorized users to access sensitive student data.

title: Network Eavesdropping
description: Data transmitted during the login and submission process may be intercepted by malicious actors if not properly encrypted.

title: Improper Data Retention
description: The Grades Portal Web App may retain submitted assignments and personal data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of exposure.

title: Unintended Data Sharing
description: The Grades Portal Web App may inadvertently share student data with third-party services without proper consent.

title: Unauthorized Access to Student Data
description: The grades portal may inadvertently allow unauthorized users to access sensitive student information during the submission process.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: Data being transmitted between the grades portal and the assignment & grading service may be intercepted, leading to exposure of sensitive information such as student IDs and course details.

title: Improper Data Handling by Service
description: The assignment & grading service may mishandle or improperly store the received data, leading to potential data breaches or unauthorized access.

title: Unauthorized Access to Student Data
description: The grading service may inadvertently expose student data (e.g., student ID, course, submission time) to unauthorized personnel during the assignment submission process.

title: Data Breach of Stored Assignments
description: The stored assignments in the Assignment Store may be vulnerable to data breaches, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive student information.

title: Interception of Data in Transit
description: Data transmitted from the grading service to the assignment store may be intercepted by malicious actors, exposing sensitive information such as student IDs and submission times.

title: Insecure Login Credentials
description: The teacher's login credentials may be intercepted during transmission, leading to unauthorized access to the Grades Portal.

title: Data Exposure in Transit
description: Data about the teacher's request and the queue of submissions may be exposed during transmission, potentially revealing sensitive information.

title: Improper Data Handling
description: The Grades Portal may improperly handle or store the teacher's data, leading to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Unintended Data Sharing
description: The Grades Portal may unintentionally share the teacher's data with unauthorized users or third parties.

title: Unauthorized Access to Student Data
description: The portal may allow unauthorized users to access student submissions, including names and work content, due to insufficient access controls.

title: Insecure Data Handling by Teacher
description: The teacher may mishandle or improperly store the student data, leading to potential data leaks or unauthorized sharing.

title: Data Exposure in Transit
description: Data transmitted from the portal to the teacher may be intercepted during transmission, exposing sensitive student information.

title: Unintended Use of Data
description: The teacher may use the student data for purposes other than grading, such as personal gain or sharing with third parties.

title: Inadvertent Disclosure of Student Information
description: The teacher may inadvertently disclose sensitive student information (e.g., student ID) when recording grades and feedback, especially if the system does not enforce strict access controls or if the teacher is not careful about what information is shared.

title: Insecure Storage of Grades and Feedback
description: The Grades Portal Web App may store grades and feedback in an insecure manner, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The Grades Portal Web App may retain grades and feedback longer than necessary, leading to potential misuse of this data if it is accessed by unauthorized individuals.

title: Data in Transit Vulnerabilities
description: The data being transmitted from the teacher to the Grades Portal Web App may be intercepted during transmission, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Unauthorized Access to Grading Service
description: An unauthorized user may gain access to the grading service and submit or modify grade records, leading to potential data breaches and integrity issues.

title: Insecure Storage of Grade Records
description: The grade records database may not have adequate security measures in place, leading to unauthorized access or data leaks.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: Grade records may be intercepted during transmission from the grading service to the database, exposing sensitive information such as student IDs and grades.

title: Improper Data Retention Policies
description: The grade records may be retained longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access and potential misuse of personal data.

title: Unclear User Consent for Data Sharing
description: Students may not be adequately informed about how their grade records will be used or shared, leading to potential violations of privacy rights.

title: Inadvertent Disclosure of Grades
description: The student may inadvertently share their request for grades with unauthorized parties, leading to potential exposure of sensitive information.

title: Insufficient Access Control
description: The Grades Portal Web App may not have adequate access controls, allowing unauthorized users to access or view the grades and feedback of students.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: There is a risk of data leakage during the transmission of the request and response, which could expose sensitive information to eavesdroppers.

title: Improper Data Retention
description: The Grades Portal Web App may retain student grades and feedback longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Unauthorized Access to Grades
description: An unauthorized user may gain access to the grades and feedback intended for a specific student due to insufficient authentication mechanisms.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The student's grades and feedback may be stored insecurely on the student's device, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Leakage through Metadata
description: Metadata associated with the data flow may inadvertently reveal information about the student or their grades, leading to potential privacy violations.

title: Unauthorized Access to Child's Grades
description: The parent may inadvertently share their login credentials with unauthorized individuals, allowing them to access sensitive information about the child’s grades.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The Grades Portal Web App may store the child's grades insecurely, making them vulnerable to unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: Data transmitted between the parent and the Grades Portal Web App may be intercepted by malicious actors, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Unauthorized Access to Grades
description: A parent may gain unauthorized access to their child's grades if proper authentication mechanisms are not in place, leading to potential misuse of sensitive information.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The parent may store the grades and feedback insecurely on their device, leading to potential unauthorized access by others.

title: Data Interception During Transmission
description: Grades and feedback may be intercepted during transmission if the data flow is not encrypted, exposing sensitive information to unauthorized parties.

title: Unauthorized Access to Administrator Account
description: An unauthorized individual may gain access to the administrator account, allowing them to create, modify, or disable accounts and parent-child links, leading to potential misuse of sensitive information.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The Grades Portal Web App may store sensitive information (names, emails, roles, relationships) insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: Data transmitted between the School Administrator and the Grades Portal Web App may be intercepted, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Improper Data Handling
description: The Grades Portal Web App may process or store data in a way that does not comply with privacy regulations, leading to potential legal issues.

title: User Misunderstanding of Data Sharing
description: The School Administrator may not fully understand the implications of sharing sensitive information, leading to unintentional privacy violations.

title: Unauthorized Access to Account Records
description: The grading service may inadvertently expose account records to unauthorized users during the writing process.

title: Inadequate Data Protection Measures
description: The account directory may not have adequate security measures in place to protect sensitive account information from unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Data Misuse by Authorized Users
description: Authorized users of the account directory may misuse the data for purposes other than intended, such as unauthorized sharing or selling of information.

title: Data Leakage During Transfer
description: There is a risk of data leakage during the transfer of account records from the grading service to the account directory, potentially exposing sensitive information.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The assignment and grading service may inadvertently share sensitive student data with the cloud hosting provider without proper consent or authorization.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: During the nightly database backup, there is a risk of data leakage where sensitive information could be intercepted while being transmitted to the cloud hosting provider.

title: Inadequate Data Protection by Third Party
description: The cloud hosting provider may not implement adequate security measures to protect the stored grade records and assignments, leading to potential data breaches.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The cloud hosting provider may retain the data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Unauthorized Access to Grade Records
description: An unauthorized user may gain access to the grade records stored in the Grade Records Database, leading to potential misuse of sensitive student information.

title: Inaccurate Data Representation
description: The Assignment & Grading Service may misrepresent or incorrectly process the grade records, leading to inaccurate views for students, parents, and teachers.

title: Data Retention Risks
description: The Assignment & Grading Service may retain grade records longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: There is a risk of data leakage during the transmission of grade records from the database to the grading service, potentially exposing sensitive information to unauthorized parties.
